source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.

adaptation: عروض الجمعة السوداء: تصل إلى 70% تخفيض على كل شيء
back_translation: Black Friday: خصم 70% على كل شيء
notes: The translation was adapted to better suit the Arabic language's sentence structure and chosen to emphasize the market-specific aspect of 'Black Friday' and the term 'discount' which is commonly used in Arabic marketing.

source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.
literal: الجمعة السوداء: خصم يصل إلى ٧٠٪ على كل شيء.
adaptation: الجمعة البيضاء: خصومات لحد ٧٠٪ على كل حاجة!
back_translation: White Friday: discounts up to 70% on everything!
notes: Because Friday is the holy day of prayer in Egypt and 'black' carries negative connotations, the event is widely rebranded as 'White Friday' (popularized by Amazon.eg/Souq), and the line uses Egyptian colloquial ('لحد', 'كل حاجة') to feel local and conversational.

source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.

back_translation: White Friday: discounts up to 70% on all products
notes: Changed 'Black Friday' to 'White Friday' because in Egypt the term 'black' has negative connotations when paired with Friday, the Islamic day of prayer, so retailers use 'White Friday' instead.

source: Black Friday: up to 70% off everything.
literal: جمعة سوداء: خصم يصل إلى 70% على كل شيء

back_translation: Black Friday Surprise: Discounts up to 70% on all products in our store!
notes: The adaptation was changed to add a more exciting element 'مفاجأة' (Surprise) to cater to Egypt's market, and 'منتجات' (products) was used instead of 'كل شيء' to specify what is on sale in a clearer, more marketable way.

back_translation: White Friday: discounts reaching up to 70% on everything.

back_translation: Black Friday: Crazy discounts up to 70% on all products.

'Up to 70% off' is translated to 'تصل الخصومات إلى 70%' to indicate a greater percentage of discounts and to make the offer more appealing.

back_translation: Black Friday Surprise: Discounts up to 70% on all products

literal: ساعة السعادة: مشروبات 2-1 من الساعة 5 مساءً حتى 7 مساءً
adaptation: اشرب براحتك مع عروضنا الحصرية خلال الساعة السعيدة! استمتع بمشروبين بسعر واحد فقط خلال الفترة من 5 مساءً حتى 7 مساءً.
back_translation: Happy hour: 2-for-1 drinks from 5 to 7pm
notes: حرصنا على استخدام تعابير محلية شائعة في مصر مثل "ساعة السعادة" و "اشرب براحتك" لجعل الإعلان أكثر تفاعلًا مع الجمهور المحلي، كما قمنا بترجمة "drink to" بدلاً من "drinks" لتجنب أي لبس.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: مشروبان بسعر واحد من الساعة 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
adaptation: ساعة الروقان: اطلب أي عصير أو موكتيل والتاني علينا، من 5 لـ 7 المسا!
back_translation: Chill-out hour: order any juice or mocktail and the second one's on us, from 5 to 7 in the evening!
notes: Because 'happy hour' strongly implies alcohol, which is sensitive in Muslim-majority Egypt and not served by most restaurants, I reframed it around juices and mocktails in friendly Egyptian colloquial Arabic, and the 5–7pm slot should be revisited during Ramadan since it overlaps with fasting before iftar.

literal: ساعة السعادة: مشروبين بسعر واحد من الساعة 5 إلى 7 مساءً
adaptation: عرض Happy Hour: اشتري مشروب واحصل على الثاني مجانًا من ٥ إلى ٧ مساءً
back_translation: Happy Hour offer: buy one drink and get the second free from 5 to 7 PM
notes: Kept 'Happy Hour' in English as it's widely recognized in urban Egypt, and avoided specifying alcohol by using the generic 'مشروب' (drink) to ensure cultural appropriateness.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: 2 مشروب مقابل 1 من 5 إلى 7 مساءً
adaptation: ساعة الفرح: اشرب واحصل على الثاني مجانًا من الساعة 5 إلى 7 مساءً
back_translation: Happy Hour: Buy one drink and get the second one free from 5 to 7 PM
notes: In Arabic, 'for' can sometimes be misleading as it's often used to denote a period of time rather than indicating ' مقابل' (for). The wording was adjusted for better understanding of the offer in an Egyptian context.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: ٢ مقابل ١ مشروبات من ٥ إلى ٧ مساءً.
adaptation: ساعة الروقان: اطلب مشروب والتاني علينا من ٥ لـ ٧ مساءً.
back_translation: Chill hour: order a drink and the second is on us from 5 to 7pm.
notes: Replaced the literal 'happy hour' with the popular Egyptian concept of 'ساعة الروقان' (chill/relaxation hour) and framed the BOGO deal as 'the second is on us' to emphasize local hospitality while keeping the promotion culturally safe regardless of whether the drinks are alcoholic or not.

literal: الساعة السعيدة: مشروبان بسعر مشروب واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
adaptation: من 5 لـ7 مساءً: اطلب مشروبين وادفع تمن واحد!
back_translation: From 5 to 7pm: Order two drinks and pay for one!
notes: استخدمنا صياغة مصرية طبيعية وكلمة «مشروبات» المحايدة لتجنّب الإيحاء بأن العرض خاص بالمشروبات الكحولية.

literal: الساعة السعيدة: مشروبان بسعر مشروب واحد من ٥ إلى ٧ مساء
adaptation: ساعة السَّمْر: ٢ ب٢ مختلفين من ٥ إلى ٧ مساء
back_translation: 'Fun hour': 2-for-2 different drinks from 5 to 7 PM
notes: Assumed 'happy hour' is culturally understood in Egypt; shifted to 'ساعة السَّمْر' (fun hour) for broader appeal and replaced 'for-1' with '2-for-2 different' to emphasize variety.

literal: ساعة السعادة: مشروبات 2 بسعر 1 من الساعة 5 حتى 7 مساءً
adaptation: استمتع بمشروباتك المفضلة في ساعة السعادة واحصل على عرض مميز: 2 بسعر 1 خلال الفترة من 5 مساءً حتى 7 مساءً.
back_translation: Happy hour: 2-for-1 drinks from 5 to 7pm
notes: حرصت على استخدام تعابير مألوفة في الثقافة السعودية مثل 'ساعة السعادة' لتشجيع العملاء على الاستفادة من العرض.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: مشروبات اثنان مقابل واحد من ٥ إلى ٧ مساءً.
adaptation: وقت الانتعاش: اطلب أي عصير أو قهوة مثلّجة والثاني علينا، من ٥ إلى ٧ مساءً.
back_translation: Refreshment time: order any juice or iced coffee and the second one's on us, from 5 to 7pm.
notes: Because alcohol is prohibited in Saudi Arabia and 'happy hour' implies alcohol, I replaced the term with 'refreshment time' and named non-alcoholic drinks; the 5–7pm window should also be checked against Maghrib prayer times and moved during Ramadan.

literal: ساعة السعادة: مشروبان بسعر واحد من الساعة 5 إلى 7 مساءً
adaptation: عرض خاص: مشروبان بسعر واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً
back_translation: Special offer: two drinks for the price of one from 5 to 7 PM
notes: Avoided the term 'happy hour' because it is widely associated with alcohol, which is culturally and legally impermissible in Saudi Arabia; all drinks are understood to be non-alcoholic.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: 2 مقابل 1 مشروبات من 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
adaptation: ساعات الألفة: صفقة 2 مقابل 1 على المشروبات من 5 إلى 7 مساءً
back_translation: Pleasant hours: 2 for 1 drink deal from 5 to 7 PM
notes: In Saudi Arabia, phrases like 'happy hour' are not commonly used due to the country's strong Islamic identity, so 'pleasant hours' is a more suitable term.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: مشروبان مقابل واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
adaptation: الساعة الذهبية: مشروبين بسعر واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
back_translation: Golden hour: Two drinks for the price of one from 5 to 7pm.
notes: Replaced 'Happy hour' with 'Golden hour' (الساعة الذهبية) to avoid Western alcohol connotations while maintaining the promotional appeal in the Saudi F&B market.

literal: الساعة السعيدة: مشروبان بسعر مشروب واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
adaptation: عرض المساء: اطلب مشروبًا واحصل على الثاني مجانًا من 5 إلى 7 مساءً.
back_translation: Evening offer: Order one drink and get the second free from 5 to 7pm.
notes: استُبدلت عبارة «الساعة السعيدة» لتجنّب ارتباطها بالعروض على المشروبات الكحولية، المحظورة في السعودية.

literal: ساعة سعيدة: مشروبان بسعر واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً
adaptation: ساعة المميز: مشروبان بسعر واحد من 5 إلى 7 مساءً
back_translation: Special hour: Two drinks for the price of one from 5 to 7 PM
notes: Replaced 'Happy hour' with 'ساعة المميز' (Special hour) to avoid Western cultural connotations and sound more natural in Saudi.

literal: 5 to 7pm, the same price of two for one drinks.
adaptation: Drop in for a G&T from £5 and enjoy 2-for-1 on all spirits for 2 happy hours a day from 5pm.
back_translation: Happy hour: 2-for-1 drinks from 5 to 7pm.
notes: Instead of using the term 'happy hour', which may not resonate as well with British audiences, the adaptation was phrased more conversational, highlighting the value proposition while incorporating the unique spirit offer.

adaptation: Happy hour: two-for-one drinks, 5–7pm. Please drink responsibly.
back_translation: Happy hour: two-for-one drinks, 5–7pm. Please drink responsibly.
notes: I adopted UK time and number styling and added a responsible-drinking line because UK licensing rules restrict 'irresponsible' drinks promotions, and Scotland bans happy hours and multi-buy drink deals outright, so this offer cannot run in Scottish venues.

back_translation: Happy hour: two for one drinks 5–7pm.
notes: Changed '2-for-1' to '2-4-1', the common British shorthand for 'two for one', and used an en dash for the time range, which is more typical in UK advertising.

literal: Happy hour: 2-for-1 drinks from 5 to 7 pm
adaptation: Happy Hour: Buy One Get One Free Drinks 5-7 PM
back_translation: Happy Hour: Buy One Get One Free Drinks 5-7 PM
notes: The phrase '2-for-1' remains relatively consistent across English-speaking countries, but the alternative 'Buy One Get One Free' is commonly used in British English, making it a more natural fit.

adaptation: Happy hour: 2 for 1 drinks from 5pm to 7pm.
back_translation: Happy hour: 2 for 1 drinks from 5pm to 7pm.
notes: Removed the hyphens in '2 for 1' and added 'pm' to the start time for standard British promotional styling, while bearing in mind that temporary alcohol price promotions are illegal in Scotland and this would only run in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

back_translation: Happy hour: two drinks for the price of one, from 5 to 7pm.
notes: ‘Happy hour’ and ‘2-for-1’ are familiar UK terms, with the time styling tightened for natural British advertising.

adaptation: Early evening offer: 2-for-1 cocktails from 5 to 7pm.
back_translation: Early evening offer: 2-for-1 cocktails from 5 to 7pm.
notes: Replaced 'happy hour' with 'early evening offer' as the term is less common in the UK and can sound overly American.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، تم ترتيبه. اطلب الديك الرومي الخاص بك اليوم.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.

back_translation: Family dinner, sorted. Order the turkey today!

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، مرتب. اطلب تركيا اليوم

back_translation: Eid al-Adha celebrations, ordered easily with Weekly Grocery app. Book your sacrificial animal now

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، جاهز. اطلب الديك الرومي اليوم.
adaptation: عزومة كبيرة؟ الديك الرومي لحد باب البيت. اطلبه النهارده.
back_translation: Big gathering? Turkey delivered right to your door. Order it today.
notes: استبدلنا عيد الشكر، غير الشائع في مصر، بفكرة العزومة الكبيرة الأكثر ارتباطًا بالثقافة المحلية.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، مُنظم. اطلب ديك رومي اليوم.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: ولَّاعَة وجبة عشاء عيد الشكر، جاهزة. طلِّب ديكًا روميًّا اليوم
adaptation: وجبة عيد الشكر مغسولة. اطلب ديك رومي اليوم - اسهل وجبتك المفضلة. ادخل الرابط.
back_translation: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today
notes: تم استخدام كلمة "اسهل" بدلاً من "طَمَّن" لتمكين التواصل مع العملاء في المملكة والتأكيد على عامل الراحة والراحة المقدمة من قبل التطبيق. كما تم إضافة رابط للتطبيق لزيادة التحويلات

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، تم ترتيبه. اطلب ديكك الرومي اليوم.
adaptation: عزيمة العيد؟ أبشر، علينا! اطلب مقاضيك اليوم.
back_translation: The Eid family feast? Consider it done, we've got you! Order your groceries today.
notes: Thanksgiving and turkey have no cultural relevance in Saudi Arabia, so the occasion was swapped for the Eid family gathering ('azeema') and the turkey for Saudi-dialect 'maqadi' (grocery shopping), with the warm local reassurance 'abshir' carrying the 'sorted' promise.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، تم الترتيب. اطلب الديك الرومي اليوم.
adaptation: وليمة العيد، جاهزة. اطلب لحم الخروف اليوم.
back_translation: Eid feast, sorted. Order your lamb today.
notes: Thanksgiving is not observed in Saudi Arabia, so the occasion was switched to the local Eid al-Adha celebration with lamb as the traditional centerpiece.

source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، مرتب. اطلب تركيا اليوم
